claims: The New York Yankees defeated the San Francisco Giants 7-0
The New York Yankees opened the 2026 MLB season on Wednesday, March 25, 2026
The game marked the New York Yankees' fifth consecutive Opening Day win
The New York Yankees had a 5-run second inning rally
The game was on Wednesday, March 25, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET
The game was at Oracle Park, San Francisco
The starting pitchers were Max Fried (NYY) and Logan Webb (SF)
Trent Grisham had a triple and two RBIs
The game was featured as "MLB Opening Night" streaming on Netflix
This matchup marked the official start of the 2026 MLB season
The general league-wide opening day was on March 26
